   * 2. Set tn.title = chainnode.title.
   * 3. Set tn.levelSeq = new ArrayList(chainnode.levelSeq).
   * 4. Set tn.levelText = chainnode.levelText.
   * 5. Set tn.content = chainnode.content.
   * 6. Set tn.parent = null.
   * 7. Initialize tn.children as an empty list.
   * 8. Return tn.
   * Related Features: ChainNode.title, ChainNode.levelSeq, ChainNode.levelText, ChainNode.content
   * Related Classes: ChainNode, TreeNode
   * Input: chainnode - ChainNode whose data is to be copied.
   * Output: New TreeNode instance.
   * Pre-condition: chainnode is not null; chainnode.levelSeq is not null.
   * Post-condition: The new TreeNode has the same heading information as the ChainNode and no children.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public TreeNode createTreeNode(final ChainNode chainnode)
  {
    TreeNode tn = ArborparserFactory.eINSTANCE.createTreeNode();
    tn.setTitle(chainnode.getTitle());
    tn.getLevelSeq().clear();
    tn.getLevelSeq().addAll(chainnode.getLevelSeq());
    tn.setLevelText(chainnode.getLevelText());
    tn.setContent(chainnode.getContent());
    tn.setParent(null);
    return tn;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Lower-level helper that creates a TreeNode from a ChainNode, attaches it to the correct ancestor in currentBranch, and updates the current-node reference. It does not automatically append the new node to currentBranch; the caller does that after the branch has been trimmed.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. tn = createTreeNode(node)
   * 2. While currentBranch is not empty and not getPrefix(node.levelSeq).equals(currentBranch.last.levelSeq):
   *      currentBranch.removeLast()
   * 3. If currentBranch is empty, reject the attachment.
   * 4. parent = currentBranch.last
   * 5. parent.addChild(tn)
   * 6. Set currentNodeRef.value = tn
   * Related Features: createTreeNode, getPrefix, currentBranch, TreeNode.addChild
   * Related Classes: AutoPruneStrategy, ChainNode, TreeNode, TreeBuildingStrategy
   * Input: node - ChainNode to attach; currentBranch - mutable branch list for finding the parent; currentNodeRef - a mutable reference holder for the newly created current TreeNode.
   * Output: None; currentBranch is trimmed to the parent and currentNodeRef refers to the newly added TreeNode.
   * Pre-condition: currentBranch contains a TreeNode whose levelSeq equals getPrefix(node.levelSeq); currentNodeRef is a mutable holder that can receive the new node.
   * Post-condition: node is linked into the tree under that ancestor, and currentNodeRef refers to the newly added TreeNode.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model currentBranchMany="true" currentNodeRefDataType="edu.arborparser.node"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void addNodeToTree(final ChainNode node, final EList<TreeNode> currentBranch, final TreeNode[] currentNodeRef)
  {
    TreeNode tn = createTreeNode(node);
    while (!currentBranch.isEmpty()
        && !getPrefix(node.getLevelSeq()).equals(currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1).getLevelSeq()))
    {
      currentBranch.remove(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    }
    if (currentBranch.isEmpty())
    {
      return;
    }
    TreeNode parent = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    parent.addChild(tn);
    currentNodeRef[0] = tn;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Attaches an immediate valid ChainNode to the nearest ancestor in currentBranch whose levelSeq is the parent prefix of the new node, and updates the current branch so that it ends at the newly attached TreeNode.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. Create a TreeNode from the ChainNode using createTreeNode.
   * 2. While currentBranch is not empty and not getPrefix(node.levelSeq).equals(currentBranch.last.levelSeq):
   *      currentBranch.removeLast()
   * 3. If currentBranch is empty, the node cannot be attached (invalid for this operation).
   * 4. Let parent = currentBranch.last; call parent.addChild(newNode).
   * 5. Append newNode to currentBranch, so the branch represents the path from root to the new node.
   * Related Features: createTreeNode, getPrefix, currentBranch, TreeNode.parent, TreeNode.children, addChild
   * Related Classes: AutoPruneStrategy, ChainNode, TreeNode, TreeBuildingStrategy
   * Input: node - the ChainNode to attach; currentBranch - mutable list of TreeNodes representing the current root-to-leaf branch.
   * Output: None; currentBranch is updated as a side effect.
   * Pre-condition: node.levelSeq is an immediate valid next node after the current branch; currentBranch is non-empty and contains a TreeNode whose levelSeq equals getPrefix(node.levelSeq).
   * Post-condition: The new TreeNode is attached as a child of the nearest suitable ancestor, and currentBranch ends with that new TreeNode.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model currentBranchMany="true"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void addNodeAndUpdateBranch(final ChainNode node, final EList<TreeNode> currentBranch)
  {
    TreeNode newNode = createTreeNode(node);
    while (!currentBranch.isEmpty()
        && !getPrefix(node.getLevelSeq()).equals(currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1).getLevelSeq()))
    {
      currentBranch.remove(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    }
    if (currentBranch.isEmpty())
    {
      return;
    }
    TreeNode parent = currentBranch.get(currentBranch.size() - 1);
    parent.addChild(newNode);
    currentBranch.add(newNode);
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   * Checks and applies the required auto-prune decision when the pending queue reaches three nodes. If all pending nodes form one immediate sibling sequence, the queue is left unchanged for the caller to attach. If they do not, the oldest pending node is removed and merged into the current node's content.
   * Algorithm:
   * 1. If queue is empty, return.
   * 2. Let firstSeq = queue.getFirst().levelSeq.
   * 3. If firstSeq is empty, merge oldest into current content and return.
   * 4. Let prefix = getPrefix(firstSeq).
   * 5. Let expected = getLastLevel(firstSeq).
   * 6. For each node in queue:
   *      seq = node.levelSeq
   *      if getPrefix(seq) != prefix or getLastLevel(seq) != expected:
   *          remove the oldest node from queue and merge it into current content.
   *          return
   *      expected = expected + 1
   * 7. If the loop completes, all nodes are an immediate sibling sequence; leave the queue unchanged.
   * Related Features: getPrefix, getLastLevel, pending queue, current node content, concatNode
   * Related Classes: AutoPruneStrategy, ChainNode, TreeNode, TreeBuildingStrategy, BaseNode
   * Input: queue - Deque of pending ChainNodes that were not immediate next nodes.
   * Output: None; as a side effect, the oldest node may be removed and merged into content, or the queue may be left unchanged.
   * Pre-condition: queue is not null.
   * Post-condition: If all nodes are immediate siblings, queue remains intact for attachment. Otherwise, the oldest node is merged into current content and removed from the queue.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model queueDataType="edu.arborparser.Deque&lt;edu.arborparser.ChainNode&gt;"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void isAllNotImmNodesSiblings(final Deque<ChainNode> queue)
  {
    if (queue.isEmpty())
    {
      return;
    }
    ChainNode first = queue.getFirst();
    EList<Integer> firstSeq = first.getLevelSeq();
    if (firstSeq.isEmpty())
    {
      if (current != null)
      {
        current.concatNode(queue.pollFirst());
      }
      else
      {
        queue.pollFirst();
      }
      return;
    }
    EList<Integer> prefix = getPrefix(firstSeq);
    int expected = getLastLevel(firstSeq);
    for (ChainNode node : queue)
    {
      EList<Integer> seq = node.getLevelSeq();
      if (!getPrefix(seq).equals(prefix) || getLastLevel(seq) != expected)
      {
        if (current != null)
        {
          current.concatNode(queue.pollFirst());
        }
        else
        {
          queue.pollFirst();
        }
        return;
      }
      expected++;
    }
  }

} // AutoPruneStrategy

## EMF Coding Style

- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

## EMF Coding Style
- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.
